note: Single source of truth for MONTAJE — the editor. Realización directs ONE performance within a shot; Montaje COMPOSES many performances between shots: cuts, split-screen, video-call grids, phone-call alternation, rhythm. This is the exponential multiplier: N single-avatar performances -> N^2 interactions by composition. Layouts give normalized cell rects [x,y,w,h] (0..1); the JS runtime / a PIL compositor draws each performance into its cell. Art: Eisenstein (montage = drama from juxtaposition).

split_2.desc: two side by side - dialogue / phone-call feel

split_2h.desc: stacked - phone call, one over the other

pip.desc: picture-in-picture - main + a small corner feed

hard_cut.desc: dry cut (Allie: cortes secos) - the default
